name: slide_write
description: Write one slide into the deck as its generator builds slides (lift-up FUNC-1), from a slide in the JSON Narrato writes (`deck_generate`'s `slides`): its layout chosen for its items, each place filled, its figures, builds, and icons, in the deck's theme and the brief it keeps. After the slide that holds `after`, in place of the slide that holds `replace` (its beat kept, its picture shown again, the nodes no other slide shows taken away with it), or at the end. Its `speakerNotes` are its first state's own wherever the beat it joins keeps notes of its own, so a presenter reads them on it. Its states join `beat`, a beat of the spine whose claim it tells (plan the spine with `spine_update` first), which keeps what it says; with none, it gets a beat of its own, and a deck with no spine yet begins one, the slide taking the place of `deck_create`'s blank slide. Its set of texts held to one size and lint's fixes taken, as a made deck's are; what no fix mends is in `left`, a text past its place first, and each item its layout sets in none of its places (a chart's takes its takeaway alone) in `unset`. One patch, refused as `deck_patch` refuses one, reported as `deck_patch` reports one (`summary`, and the JSON Patch only with `verbose`), with the slide's states, layout, and beat: a beat whose claim the slide it takes the place of said, and its new headline does not, is in `restated`, with the `fix` that sets the claim to that headline.

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

slide.description:
One slide, as Narrato writes each of `deck_generate`'s `slides`: `slideTitle`, `subtitle`,
`layoutSuggestion`, `keyBullets`, `speakerNotes`, and `chartData`, `icons`, `beatName`,
`purpose`, `intent`, `expectedIntensity`, and `expectedValence` where it has them. A
`chartData.sourceId` that names one of the deck's data sources (`data_attach`), by its id
or its file's name, else a `sourceRef` that does, draws the chart from it where the file
holds the slide's categories and figures; else the chart keeps its own rows, and `unbound`
says why.

after.description: The slide goes after the slide that holds this state.

replace.description:
The slide is written in place of the slide that holds this state, with all its steps, in
its beat. Without it or `after`, the slide goes after every slide.

beat.description:
The id of a beat of the spine whose claim this slide tells, as `spine_update` planned it:
the slide's states join it, and it keeps its claim, evidence, and notes, the slide giving
only what it lacks (Narrato's fields); the slide's own `speakerNotes` go on its first
state, which a presenter reads before the beat's; without `after`, the slide stands where the spine plans it,
after that beat's slides, else after the nearest earlier beat's, else before the nearest
later beat's. Without it, the slide gets a beat of its own after the slide
before it, and a deck with no spine yet begins one. Not with `replace`, which keeps the
beat of the slide it takes the place of.

id.description:
The slide's state's id, and its nodes' after it (`proposal-header`), where the slide would
be named after its headline (agent dogfood 6): refused where the deck has it already.

dry_run.description: Say what would change, and write nothing.

verbose.description:
The patch compiled to JSON Patch too (`patch`), which a slide makes long: every state of
the deck, as `deck_patch`'s `verbose` gives it.
